chunks: When the apostles despaired and thought they were made false promises, Our help arrived, and We delivered whom We pleased; but never will Our punishment be averted from the sinners.
ai.seo_question: When does divine help arrive for the prophets according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the climax of Prophet Yusuf's narrative, illustrating the principle of 'istishhad' (testimony) where divine aid arrives precisely when human hope is exhausted. It underscores the inevitability of Allah's decree (Qadr) and serves as a paradigm for the Imams, who, despite facing political and social despair, remain the locus of divine salvation. The phrase 'punishment cannot be repelled' emphasizes the certainty of retribution for the arrogant, reinforcing the theological concept of divine justice.
